summary: OpenWorld, Inc. (formerly VerifyMe, Inc.) filed an 8-K/A correcting its September 30, 2026 current report on the closing of its reverse merger with Open World Ltd. (Cayman). Under the February 11, 2026 Merger Agreement, VRME Subsidiary Corp. merged into Legacy OpenWorld at 11:00 a.m. ET on September 30, 2026, with Legacy OpenWorld surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary; the registrant is the acquirer and changed its name to OpenWorld, Inc., effective October 1, 2026. The amendment corrects issued shares to 11,686,124 and warrants to 300,000. No price, premium or advisor named. Watch the shareholder-overhang and post-merger Nasdaq compliance risk.
